note: Plugin names are Codex capabilities, not pip/npm dependencies. Account login, availability and permissions must be checked on the recipient's host. No plugin is needed for the portable core.

core.description: Governance, memory, hooks, model advice and scoped Graphify

publisher-design.description: Faithful web design, browser-based visual review and code review

editorial.description: Reader-facing prose and document/PDF review; local Humanizer remains a separate skill

office.description: Word/PDF/table/presentation artefacts when the task actually needs them

vercel-hosting.description: Only for projects explicitly hosted on Vercel

sites-hosting.description: Only for projects explicitly built/published with OpenAI Sites

notion-operations.description: Only when Notion is an authorized project data source
